title: dailies-calibration.json
description: Written by dailies calibrate (conformal threshold) and dailies fit (per-rule weights) into one file; either half may be absent because either command can run first.

lambda.description: Kill threshold on the judge's kill score; null when the gold set cannot support the guarantee.

needed.description: Gold-pass takes required before lambda exists at this alpha.

weights.description: Per-rule logistic weights fitted to the user's gold verdicts.
